clusters.name: pattern-doc
clusters.executionModeRationale: Pure documentation; touches only a new file under plans/. No code dependency, can land in parallel with mailbox-core.

clusters.name: mailbox-core
clusters.executionModeRationale: New directory + new files; no overlap with existing happy-cli files. Foundational for everything in phase 2.

clusters.name: wiring
clusters.executionModeRationale: The three wiring stories (bridge send tool + producer-emit, daemon-route, recovery-helper + runCodex wiring) touch DISJOINT existing files and all depend only on the mailbox.ts API surface from cluster mailbox-core. They can run as parallel sub-jobs in v5.28 continuous-DAG mode because file-footprints don't overlap. Risk medium because edits to runCodex.ts and happyMcpStdioBridge.ts are load-bearing code paths; reviewer must verify no regression to non-agent-comms event handling.

clusters.name: fixtures
clusters.executionModeRationale: Single new test file containing both fixtures (happy-path + missed-wake) that share setup helpers. Must run after all of wiring lands; the missed-wake fixture is the acceptance gate proving the full end-to-end contract.
